The USB-ready ZIP includes default.xex, update-installer.xex and Assets/blades.xzp.
Extract Blades-v0.52-USB.zip onto USB and launch Blades/default.xex.
Keep update-installer.xex beside default.xex for automatic updates.
No DashLaunch plugin, video helper, DLL or artwork converter is required.
See artwork notices for sources and attribution.
